fixes.explanation: Paul says the opposite here. He writes, "We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one." Nothing at all is a pretty strong way to put it. It's a lot of fuss over something Paul calls nothing at all.

Right, Paul says an idol is "…nothing at all in the world…" He adds that there is no God but one (1 Corinthians 8:4). So the answer is False, however fancy the idol looks. A statue can have the best paint job in town and still be nothing at all in the world.
